greeting.zh: 您好，这里是 ABC 补习中心，感谢联系我们！
greeting.en: Hello, this is ABC Tuition Centre. Thanks for contacting us!
greeting.ms: Hai, ini ABC Tuition Centre. Terima kasih kerana menghubungi kami!

menu.zh:
请回复数字：
1 收费
2 试课预约
3 地址与时间
0 人工客服
menu.en:
Reply with a number:
1 Fees
2 Book a trial class
3 Address & hours
0 Talk to a person
menu.ms:
Balas dengan nombor:
1 Yuran
2 Tempah kelas percubaan
3 Alamat & waktu
0 Bercakap dengan staf

after_hours.zh: 现在是非营业时间，老师会在营业时间尽快回复您。
after_hours.en: We are closed right now. A teacher will reply during opening hours.
after_hours.ms: Kami tutup sekarang. Guru akan membalas pada waktu operasi.

fallback.zh: 收到，老师会尽快回复您。
fallback.en: Got it, a teacher will get back to you shortly.
fallback.ms: Diterima, guru akan membalas sebentar lagi.

handoff.zh: 好的，已通知老师，请稍候。
handoff.en: Sure, a teacher has been notified. One moment.
handoff.ms: Baik, guru telah dimaklumkan. Sila tunggu.

reply.zh: 小学 RM120/月，中学 RM180/月，每周两堂。首次试课免费。
reply.en: Primary RM120/month, secondary RM180/month, two classes a week. First trial class is free.
reply.ms: Sekolah rendah RM120/bulan, menengah RM180/bulan, dua kelas seminggu. Kelas percubaan pertama percuma.

reply.zh: 请告诉我们孩子的年级、科目和方便的时间，老师会安排试课。
reply.en: Please tell us the child's grade, subject and a convenient time. A teacher will arrange the trial.
reply.ms: Sila beritahu darjah anak, subjek dan masa yang sesuai. Guru akan mengatur kelas percubaan.

reply.zh: 地址：Jalan Example 12, Puchong。周一至周六 9:00–18:00。
我们有线上课程，用 Zoom 上课，收费与实体课相同。
reply.en: Yes, we offer online classes on Zoom at the same fee as in-person classes.
reply.ms: Ya, kami ada kelas online melalui Zoom dengan yuran yang sama.

ai.facts: ABC Tuition Centre, Puchong. Primary RM120/month, secondary RM180/month. Mon-Sat 9:00-18:00. Subjects: Maths, Science, English, Chinese, Malay. Free first trial class.
